# Dreamers for Copilot CLI

Start with /dreamers-help or /dreamers <task>. An approved proposal is the default plan; implementation begins immediately. Detailed planning is opt-in.

Vigil reviews code automatically. Sentinel, Probe, and Hone require explicit selection. Reviews end with a concrete simplicity assessment. Meaningful verification, test timings, retros, improvements, manual testing gates, and PR approval remain part of delivery.

See the [full guide](../README.md) for commands, installation, review options, and package validation.
